## 1a58c96bb078

**Classification: reproduced curriculum shortcut.** Generator SHA-256 `3d8657b314646298e1c6301cc1ad804b3389b38376e46eb76dbdadad39faf6d4`; canonical rule hash `341c4a414d7c`.

The intended rule changes cyan body cells under nonzero top-row headers and leaves every other cell unchanged. I sampled 300 inputs in each of easy, medium, and hard using seed `audit-seed` and sample indices 0–299: **0/900** contained any nonzero, non-8 cell below row 0. Therefore a destructive rival—start from blank, copy row 0, and draw only recolored 8 markers—agrees on the entire sampled generator support.

A canonical training input accepted by `self_check` contains an unrelated body color 6 at `(6,0)`. The selected Racket rule preserves it; the rival erases it. The exact input, reference output, rival output, one-cell difference, hashes, sample census, and supported Racket command are in `checks/audits/1a58c96bb078/finding.json` and `racket.json`. This is a concrete preservation shortcut, not merely missing axis metadata. No fix was made because this was an audit-only target.
